history.note: Published $0.115/$0.46 matched no qwen-flash price in any Alibaba region or tier. Alibaba Model Studio lists qwen-flash International (Singapore) at $0.05 in / $0.40 out for the 0<Token≤256K tier (256K–1M tier bills $0.25/$2.00). Data correction, not a market move: Alibaba did not cut this price on 2026-07-28. Supersedes the wrong baseline+carry-forward span. Root cause: all 6 Alibaba rows cited /model-studio/models, a page carrying no prices, so the row could never be re-verified.

2026-06-25 hand baseline copied Cohere's legacy 'Command' FAQ row ($1/$2) onto Command A; the Cohere API surface lists $2.50/$10 (verified against LiteLLM current 2026-07-04; Vercel AI Gateway pass-through matches). Data correction, not a market move; supersedes the wrong baseline and carried-forward span.

A 2026-06-25 scrape wrote an unsourced output_per_mtok=$1.00 placeholder into all 7 tracked Groq models at once and held it across six snapshots until a verified scrape reverted it on 2026-07-04. The identical $1.00 across a whole provider, with no `source` field, is a scrape/parse fallback, not a market move (it manufactured 12 phantom price moves incl. a +707.7% on Llama 3.1 8B Instant). The true output price was unchanged across the span (verified equal on both sides of the gap). Data correction: the phantom span is flattened to the true value; this boundary point is relabeled from a price-move event to `correction` and supersedes the placeholder span.

No host sells or verifiably sold this model per-token (OpenRouter routes zero endpoints; DeepInfra catalog has no entry), so there is no seller to re-attribute the row to. Not a market move.

Attribution correction, not a market move: $1.20/$1.20 is real but it is DEEPINFRA's rate (our own 2026-07-09 receipt of DeepInfra's Nemotron pricing guide prints 'Llama-3.1-Nemotron-70B-Instruct 128K $1.20 $1.20'; api.deepinfra.com/models/list still carries it at $1.20/$1.20 with deprecated=2026-07-16). It was published under provider NVIDIA, which has never sold per-token access (build.nvidia.com 2026-08-08: Free Endpoint Deprecated, Partner Endpoint Not available, no price printed; the early 'MOD-2 confirmation' cited that same price-less page). Row re-attributed to DeepInfra and marked Retired (DeepInfra delisted ~2026-07-16). Price values unchanged across the span.
